title: chough correct leaves a blank line inside the Timeline list
symptom: A correction is appended after the file's trailing blank line, so the Timeline becomes a loose Markdown list for good
trigger: chough correct on a session whose Timeline ends the file
expected: The correction joins the Timeline list as ordinary saves do (REQ-history-010)
actual: A blank line separates the correction from the entries before it
environment: local-macos-arm64, tester clone at 367dc86b, debug build, SpecSync 6.2.0
impact: The Timeline renders as a loose list; every byte is kept
source: t37j, test stage, areas sessions and bugs

notes.text: status: open -> investigating. Red at 5f167167 (leif/0.6.0-test1-red: d854ce1a plus the regression tests 558386f3): TC-history-a-correction-keeps-the-timeline-one-list failed for this bug's reason; fix in bc8ac154.
